mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Sunshine project: historic mine (one of the most prolific US silver/antimony producers, 360M+ oz silver produced historically) plus permitted refinery. Private company — no production, cost, or reserve figures publicly disclosed. Closed US$75M equity financing September 2025 (led by majority shareholder Electrum Silver US LLC, affiliate of The Electrum Group) to fund development toward large-scale production targeted 2028; debt-free balance sheet. Project framed as the sole fully vertically integrated, permitted US project for silver, antimony, gallium and germanium.
